component.name: OxiDisc
component.summary: Extract audio CDs to FLAC, MP3, WAV, Ogg Vorbis, or Opus

description.p: OxiDisc detects audio CDs, looks up album metadata, and extracts selected tracks to FLAC, MP3, WAV, Ogg Vorbis, or Opus files.

It supports multi-provider metadata cascade via MusicBrainz (with Cover Art Archive integration), GnuDB (FreeDB), and AcoustID acoustic audio fingerprinting, alongside dual frontends (pure-Rust egui GUI and Ratatui TUI).

ul.li: Added pure-Rust native Windows CDDA extraction and DiscID calculation without external tools.
Added modern egui GUI and full Ratatui TUI (Terminal User Interface).
Added AcoustID acoustic audio fingerprinting recognition via Chromaprint.
Added GnuDB (FreeDB) metadata lookup and multi-provider automatic cascade.
